input.rationale: The agreement contains post-termination transition and data-return machinery running in our favour, so no insert is needed. Section 14.3 (p0782–p0789) requires SFJ, on any termination, to assign sole ownership of the Trial Data Package and Research Results to PB, assign and physically deliver true, correct and complete copies of all Product Filings within a specified period, disclose all previously-undisclosed Research Results, either wind down at SFJ's cost or transfer control of and continue running the Clinical Trials for a transition period to avoid interruption, and assign and provide transition cooperation on all Clinical Trial, CRO and other Vendor Agreements. Section 11.1.1.4 (p0663) makes ownership of the Trial Data Package transfer to PB on termination, and Section 3.11.1 (p0335) gives PB the right to receive copies of all Clinical Trial data, CRFs and the Clinical Trials Master File on request (or destruction at our option). Section 10.3 (p0640) adds return-or-destroy of Confidential Information at the disclosing party's direction with written officer certification of destruction, which is the certified-deletion element of the preferred position. This meets the preferred position on the material terms (transition assistance, data return, certified deletion). Minor points noted only: the delivery period in Section 14.3.3 and the trial-continuation period in Section 14.3.4 are redacted ([***]) rather than fixed at 30 days/6 months, and no "machine-readable format" standard is specified — we should confirm those redacted periods are at least 30 days and 90 days respectively, but they are not independent deviations.
